title: IMAGEDEF source-callback retention by import generation and handle
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Retain complete DRW_ImageDef callback values in the dwg2dxf adapter
Bind IMAGE-to-IMAGEDEF callbacks by import generation and source handle
Reject ambiguous duplicate source identities without overwriting retained values

implementation.summary: dx_data owns copied DRW_ImageDef values keyed by (importGeneration, sourceHandle). dx_ifaceImg records its source import generation. linkImage retains full definitions, binds paths only to matching-generation images, and records invalid or duplicate keys without replacing earlier state. Generated controls cover shared definitions, two definitions with the same path, complete typed metadata/callback-owned carriers, source mutation, generation isolation, invalid handles, and duplicate-handle conflict behavior.

assessment.claim: The adapter retains complete typed IMAGEDEF callback state for each unambiguous import-generation/source-handle identity and no longer binds callbacks across reused-container generations.
assessment.coverage: Generated controls verify class version, pixel dimensions/sizes, loaded/resolution state, owner, extension-dictionary handle, reactors, appData, XDATA, shared references, distinct same-path source identities, copied ownership after source mutation, invalid handles, and duplicate-key refusal. The controls run through the existing generated image-path CLI CTest.
assessment.limitations: The retained definition map is not yet consumed by the DXF writer. Definition metadata/reactors are not yet serialized; source-to-emitted handle planning, IMAGE 340/360 closure, IMAGEDEF dictionary ownership, atomic output rollback, repeated ASCII/Binary semantic preservation, independent reader acceptance, native acceptance, and support claims remain unqualified. This is not complete PAR-59/7P.5b work.

planImpact.nextAction: 7P.5b.2: preplan source IMAGEDEF-to-emitted identity bindings and serialize full definitions/reactors transactionally while preserving legacy filename-only API behavior.
